description:
Builds on US-001's logs/traces/metrics foundation: dashboards, distributed tracing UX, SLOs for the sales path, and an on-sale load-test harness that runs the festival-scale NFR profile. Design-target on-sale (owner NFR): ~50-100k capacity event, 100k+ concurrent buyers in the waiting room, thousands of checkout attempts/min sustained.

**Conditions of Success:**
- A simulated on-sale run yields traces/dashboards that localize the bottleneck service
- Load harness replays the NFR profile (100k+ queue, thousands of checkouts/min) against Compose and reports pass/fail vs targets
- Golden-signal alerts fire locally during induced failures

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map). Origin: backlog grilling 2026-07-12.

comments.body: COS defined at epic level; decompose when prioritized (Gate 1). Blind spot found in review: five services + an event bus with nobody owning how you debug them.
